results.trackName: The Travels of Dr. Rebecca Harper A Matter of Time
results.description:
A Single Moment Destroys Everything She Thought Her Life Would Be

It's 1981, and Rebecca Harper's future is perfectly mapped out. She received her veterinary degree, secured her first clinical position, and built a life with the husband and daughter she loves. Everything is finally falling into place — until a freak riding accident changes everything.

Disoriented and injured, Rebecca stumbles into a nearby town that looks eerily familiar, like the Western television shows she adored as a child. But this is no movie set. It is 1856.

Alone, frightened, and unable to reveal the truth about where—or when—she comes from, Rebecca must learn to survive in a society where women are expected to stay silent and outsiders are rarely welcomed. With no clear path home, she begins a desperate search to return to her husband, her daughter, and the life she lost in a single moment.

Using only her basic veterinary training, modern knowledge, and determination, Rebecca slowly builds a place for herself in a harsh and unfamiliar world. As her travels take her across a rapidly changing America, she witnesses history unfold around her, crossing paths with remarkable figures and world-changing events, including the Civil War and the lives of Abraham Lincoln, Mark Twain, Clara Barton, and Oliver Wendell Holmes.

But time moves forward. As Rebecca becomes woven into the fabric of the past, she must confront a devastating question: if she cannot find a way back to her own time, can she build a future in a world that was never meant to be hers?

Fans of western television will enjoy this book and series.

Book 2 Dr. Rebecca Harper-Buchanan's journey through the nineteenth century continues, now firmly anchored at the demanding and ever-changing Cattle Creek Ranch.

Trained as both a physician and a veterinarian, Rebecca faces the daily reality of caring for animals and people alike without the modern medicines and technology she once depended on. Each decision carries real consequences in a world where illness, injury, and uncertainty are constant companions—and where survival often depends on ingenuity and resolve.

Married to Sam Buchanan and newly established as the Queen of the Cattle Creek Ranch, Rebecca must balance the needs of her growing family with the relentless demands of medical practice in the booming Nevada town of Virginia City. As she navigates frontier medicine, she soon discovers that healing bodies is often easier than managing the complicated relationships, expectations, and tensions that come with ranch life.

In her first year in Nevada, personal and professional challenges collide. Family conflicts threaten the fragile peace she has worked so hard to build, and the dangers of frontier life are never far away. When Sam leaves on an urgent overseas journey to save the life of his son—and then disappears without a word—Rebecca is left facing agonizing uncertainty.

With no news and no way to know the truth, Rebecca is forced to confront the possibility that she may be alone once again, stranded in a century not her own. Should she attempt to return to her former life and time, or is her future now bound to the past? And as history continues to unfold around her, is her life becoming as dramatic and perilous as the Western stories she once loved as a child?

As Rebecca struggles to protect her family, her patients, and her place in this unforgiving world, she must find the strength to endure loss, uncertainty, and danger—all while refusing to surrender the life she has fought to claim.

Rich with historical detail, emotional depth, and frontier adventure, this next chapter in The Travels of Dr. Rebecca Harper explores love, resilience, and the courage required to survive when the past refuses to let go.
